source.title: Irish News, 6 May 1936, p. 9
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the eight uncontested divisions and names read from the News-Letter's Ulster nominations report (7 May 1936, p. 15), which prints the complete Belfast Rural Council list

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on 6 May 1936. There were contests in Carnmoney (John Davidson and Reginald L. Hamilton) and Jordanstown (Samuel Graham and Herbert Robinson); the results of those two polls were not traced, so only the eight uncontested divisions are recorded here. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Antrim that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
